The Longhorns are averaging just 305.3 total yards and 22.7 points per game over their last three games, compared with 417.3 yards and 37.7 points over their first three contests. Utah has dominated on the ground, averaging 191.4 rushing yards per game (28th in the nation) on 5.0 yards per carry (23rd), led by Wayshawn Parker.
